summary: Tested new Audit Log module (SuperAdmin only). All 11 backend tests passed (pytest). Frontend E2E: superadmin sees 'Auditoría' menu, page renders with 4 metric cards, table shows 30 rows, filters/refresh work; admin correctly does NOT see the menu and is redirected to /dashboard when accessing /auditoria directly. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: audit-logs endpoint correctly requires superadmin role via require_role('superadmin'); MongoDB _id is excluded from response ({"_id": 0}).
Backend: search filter uses $regex without escaping user input; potential ReDoS risk if search term contains regex metachars. Consider re.escape() on search value.
Backend: date_from/date_to filter compares against ISO string timestamps; works because timestamps are stored as ISO strings, but consider using proper datetime for reliability.
Frontend: AuditLogs.js has clean data-testid attributes (audit-logs-page, refresh-audit-logs, search-audit, audit-row-{id}, nav-auditoria). Good testability.
Frontend: ProtectedRoute correctly enforces requiredPermission='view_audit_logs' — admin gets redirected to /dashboard.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use existing audit log data (47 records in system).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audit Log module fully working. Endpoints: GET /api/security/audit-logs (paginated w/ filters: action, user_id, date_from, date_to, search), GET /api/security/audit-actions, GET /api/security/status. Route: /auditoria — superadmin only. Frontend page: /app/frontend/src/pages/AuditLogs.js.
